import math

x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
best_diff = 1e9
num = 0
den = 0

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    lcm = y * i // math.gcd(int(y), i)
    ip = int(x * (lcm // y))
    if ip % (lcm // i) == 0:
        ip //= (lcm // i)
    else:
        val = float(ip)
        denom = float(lcm // i)
        val = (val / denom) + 0.49
        ip = int(val)
    ip_d = float(ip)
    current_diff = abs(x / y - ip_d / float(i))
    if best_diff > current_diff:
        best_diff = current_diff
        num = ip
        den = i

g = math.gcd(num, den)
num //= g
den //= g
print(f"{num}/{den}")
